slot.brief: A cyclic process on a P–V diagram; compute net work done in the cycle by comparing areas of expansion and compression strokes.

stem: An ideal gas expands isobarically at $250$ kPa from $1.0$ m$^3$ to $3.0$ m$^3$, then returns to its initial volume by isobaric compression at $100$ kPa. The connecting strokes are isochoric. The net work done by the gas per cycle is

verdicts.working: Expansion work = 250 kPa × 2 m³ = 500 kJ; compression work = 100 kPa × (−2 m³) = −200 kJ. Net work = 300 kJ.

working:
$W_{\text{net}}=W_{\text{exp}}+W_{\text{comp}}$; isochoric strokes do zero work.
$W_{\text{net}}=(250-100)(3.0-1.0)\text{ kPa m}^3=300$ kJ
